name: sparkx-product-diagnosis
description: Diagnose product-level (ASIN) health: rank products by spend/sales/ACOS, segment the catalog into a lifecycle tier (star / core / long-tail / new / declining), compare sibling variants under a parent ASIN, produce a diagnostic card for flagged underperformers (inventory/eligibility/buy-box issues, correlated operation-log changes), and give keep/optimize/cut recommendations. Use when the user asks "我哪些 ASIN 有问题", "变体谁在拖后腿", "新品该不该继续投", "product diagnosis", "ASIN health check". Not for account-wide structural share analysis (use sparkx-ads-structure-analysis) or periodic WoW/MoM recaps (use sparkx-weekly-ads-report / sparkx-monthly-ads-report).
